continuity.arc_goal: Implement complete linked services system across three phases: Phase A (object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade), Phase A.2 (refactor completion model from LinkedFrom-as-sink to unified response_sinks on both VO and WI; eliminate LinkCompletionSink type), Phase B (workflow invocation linking with InvocationEdges, StartLinkedCommand, coupled link+invocation semantics, InvocationStatus::Completing, and full link matrix: VO↔VO, VO↔WI, WI↔VO, WI↔WI). All phases functionally complete and code-reviewed; all review findings addressed.

Branch now at 30 commits, 178/178 worker tests passing, fmt/clippy clean.
progress_update.goal: Complete linked services Phase A.2 + Phase B: unified completion dispatch model, full link matrix (VO↔VO, VO↔WI, WI↔VO, WI↔WI), InvocationStatus::Completing lifecycle, AttachServiceCommand for WI→VO awaiting, Option A command/handle split, clean and reviewable code that preserves Phase A behaviors. accomplished: Implemented Phase A (Session 5): ServiceEdges table, ServiceNodeId, VirtualObjectStatus::Completed, LinkServiceCommand, CompleteServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceCommand with journal types, proto, codec, outbox, WAL dispatch, state machine handlers; fixed 3 code review findings (cycle detection, external state mutation, failure encoding); 9 commits, 6/6 tests

Designed Phase A.2 + B (Session 6): produced plan_phase_a2.md, plan_phase_b.md, combined 25-subtask breakdown with dependency analysis and parallel execution waves; key innovations: LinkedFrom-as-completion-sink model, LinkCompletionSink enum, LinkCompletionNotification unified message, InvocationEdges table, StartLinkedCommand with link response sink, coupled link+invocation semantics

Implemented Phase A.2 refactor (Session 7): eliminated LinkCompletionSink type entirely; replaced with ServiceInvocationResponseSink::ServiceCompletion(ServiceCompletionTarget); refactored VirtualObjectStatus to struct variants (Locked { invocation_id, response_sinks } / Unlocked { response_sinks }) with Completed staying as tuple variant (type-enforced terminal); EdgeState::LinkedFrom simplified to presence-only; unified response_sinks on both VO and WI entity types instead of maintaining two dispatch pipes; fixed two critical code review findings (C1: idempotent dedup hang, C2: unsafe JSON encoding)

Completed Option A split for Unlink commands: UnlinkServiceCommand/UnlinkInvocationCommand split by target type, added completion flow (previously @no_completion), polymorphic UnlinkRequest/UnlinkResponse for cross-partition

Session 8 — Option A retention refactor: moved completion_retention_duration and journal_retention_duration from LinkRequest to ServiceCompletionTarget sink struct (proto fields 3,4); updated all codec spots; simplified fire_service_completion and send_response_to_sinks signatures; added end-to-end test link_service_command_with_handler_fires_on_child_completion; fixed M5 perf (on_link_request now reads VirtualObjectStatus once); consolidated Rec #1 (invocation_edges_table::remote_type re-exports service_edges_table::remote_type)

Fixed HIGH-1/HIGH-3: documented 1-hop cycle detection limitation prominently, removed stale 'Stub handlers' comment

Fixed all MEDIUM findings: removed dead LinkCompletionSink proto, optimized double VirtualObjectStatus read in on_unlink_request, added debug_assert for WI-only invariant, documented get_invocation_metadata_mut Completing exclusion
Added 2 new integration tests (kill_completing_invocation_force_completes, cancel_completing_invocation_force_completes) — 178/178 worker tests pass

Full workspace validation: cargo nextest run --all-features to catch any cross-crate regressions
SDK implementation scope — Rust SDK needs to expose Link, StartLinked, AttachService, AttachInvocation, UnlinkService, UnlinkInvocation commands
Consider whether release notes entry is needed for linked services feature
constraints: Phase A behaviors preserved: cycle detection, GC cascade, external state mutation guard, stale edge cleanup, JSON failure encoding in onCompleted handler
VirtualObjectStatus::Completed is type-enforced terminal (no response_sinks field)
LinkedFrom edges are presence-only — all callback data lives in target entity's response_sinks
WI unlinker MUST NOT filter response_sinks (would break WI blocking on attach sink)
has_links flag on InFlightInvocationMetadata still gates RocksDB scans in end_invocation
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None, Duration fields unwrap_or_default)
ServiceCompletionTarget carries retention_duration and journal_retention_duration for spawned handlers
1-hop cycle detection is a known limitation — transitive cycles (A→B→C→A) are not detected
decisions: Kill/cancel of Completing invocations force-completes using stored result via resume_completing_invocation — children keep running independently but parent is unblocked
1-hop cycle detection accepted as initial tradeoff — documenting limitation rather than implementing bounded BFS, since Completing lifecycle will surface deadlocks

MEDIUM-2 (has_links round-trip in on_link_from_invocation) kept as-is with documentation — adding has_links to PreFlightInvocationMetadata would require plumbing through scheduled/inboxed/vqueue paths that never need it

Option A: store retention on ServiceCompletionTarget sink rather than threading through send_response_to_sinks at every call site — semantically correct (linker owns retention), eliminates parameter-threading bug class entirely
CompleteServiceCommand now uses linker's retention (via sink) not completer's — resolves the semantic ambiguity from retention_inheritance_review Critical #2
Single canonical definition for remote_type in service_edges_table, re-exported by invocation_edges_table
Unified response sinks on both VO and WI entity types rather than maintaining two dispatch pipes (LinkedFrom-based for VO completion, response_sinks for WI)
VirtualObjectStatus::Locked/Unlocked gain inline response_sinks as struct variants; Completed has no sinks field (type-enforced terminal state)
Two link establishment paths: Path A (LinkServiceCommand → LinkRequest round-trip) for existing children; Path B (StartLinkedCommand → ServiceInvocation.link_from piggyback) for new WI children
Already-completed target short-circuits: on_link_request fires handler immediately with stored result, emits LinkCompletionNotification for edge transition, sends LinkResponse(Ok)
Option A split for unlink commands: UnlinkServiceCommand (VO target) / UnlinkInvocationCommand (WI target) — type-level split at command layer only
Two edge tables: ServiceEdges (VO parents, service-level) + InvocationEdges (WI parents, invocation-scoped)
ServiceEdgeState uses proto oneof to unify edge label + state — no separate edge_label param on put_service_edge
onCompleted handler encodes failure details as JSON in typed FailurePayload (not format-string) — safe for special characters
